review_id.description: The id of the review you worked, such as cr_01...

action.description: STAGED: you staged a candidate for the reviewer. NOTHING_TO_STAGE: the current candidate already holds, or no candidate can work. SKIPPED: you could not work the review. NEEDS_HUMAN: only a human can decide the review, such as a ListingSource without product pages (NO_PATTERN); you staged nothing and the summary holds your evidence.

candidate_version.description: The review's candidate version after your last change, or the one you read.

summary.description: What you staged and how you tested it, naming the page URLs.

risks.description: What may still be wrong, one entry each.
